# CineStager

> CineStager is a previsualization (previs) app for iPhone and iPad that lets filmmakers plan shots before the shoot day. Scan a location (LiDAR, photoreal Gaussian splats, or Hybrid), frame it with real camera bodies and lenses in Viewfinder, AR or Game mode, see true-to-life depth of field and the sun's path for any date and time, block the scene with posable mannequins, and capture stills, RAW photos with a film look, video and top-down maps for the crew.

CineStager is built by cinematographer Yannick Giraud and is free to download on the Apple App Store. Every feature is free for 7 days; after that a one-time purchase of €19.99 unlocks the app for good, with no subscription. It requires iOS 18.6 or later; some features need specific hardware (see Device requirements).

## Modes

- **Viewfinder**: a director's viewfinder. The device's own cameras, ultra-wide included, show what a chosen cine camera and lens will see, with framelines. No scan needed.
- **AR**: places a scanned location around you at 1:1 scale; walk it and block real actors inside it with people occlusion.
- **Game**: fly a virtual camera with joysticks through a location, anywhere.
- Camera, lens, scene, date and time carry over between modes.

## Scan

- Built-in LiDAR scanner with three kinds of scan: **LiDAR** (precise model, ready in minutes), **Gaussian splats** (photoreal, trained on the device) and **Hybrid** (LiDAR model up close, splats beyond the scanner's reach).
- Import any USDZ (also from Blender, SketchUp or Unreal Engine) or Gaussian splats from a .ply file.
- Location Library: crop locations, multi-storey buildings with a floor switch, saved scenes, share a whole location (model, splats, floors, geography) as one .csloc file, iCloud sync between iPhone and iPad.
- Locations get a place on earth and north, used by Sunseeker.

## Frame

- Camera bodies and sensor modes from ARRI, Sony, Canon, RED, Fujifilm, Blackmagic, Nikon, Panasonic and DJI (Ronin 4D), plus film formats: Super 8, 16 mm, 35 mm, VistaVision, 65 mm and IMAX.
- 34 zooms, 31 prime sets, 14 anamorphic zooms and 33 anamorphic prime sets; front and rear adapters, T-stops (converted to real f-numbers for depth of field), custom lens sets, large format 65.
- True-to-life depth of field from focal length, stop, sensor and real distances: in Game mode on any device, in AR from LiDAR depth. Focus stays on a mannequin when it is moved, turned or posed.
- Lens character: vintage looks, swirly bokeh, soap-bubble highlights and anamorphic stretch.

## Light

- Sunseeker draws the sun's path over the shot for any date and time. In AR and Viewfinder it works without a location (device location and compass; tap the real sun in AR to set north exactly). Game mode uses the location's place and north, set under Geography in the Location Library.

## Block

- Eight mannequins in five poses (standing, walking, sitting, on the ground, lying) with custom skin, hair, top and bottom colours and adjustable height; switching pose keeps position, direction and height.
- People occlusion for blocking real actors in AR.

## Capture and share

- Stills with a top-down map of camera and actor positions; clean video (optional sound) with a map of the camera's route and how people moved; camera, lens and stop in the metadata.
- Apple ProRAW DNG with each photo in Viewfinder mode (iPhone Pro); in the Shot Library it gets an adjustable film look (exposure, white balance, tint, 8/16/35 mm grain). Share the photo, the film-look JPEG or the DNG.
- Link a location to shots taken without one, afterwards.
- Shots and maps appear automatically in CinePlanner (https://cineplannerapp.com), the shot-list app by the same maker, through iCloud.

## Device requirements

- Viewfinder, AR, Game mode, Sunseeker, mannequins: any iPhone or iPad with iOS 18.6 or later.
- LiDAR scanning and depth of field in AR: an iPhone Pro or iPad Pro with LiDAR.
- Gaussian splats and Hybrid scans: LiDAR, iOS 27, and an A14 / M1 chip or newer.
- ProRAW with film look: an iPhone Pro, in Viewfinder mode.
- Ultra-wide lenses: Viewfinder mode only (AR uses the main camera).

## Key facts

- Platform: iOS (iPhone and iPad), iOS 18.6 or later
- Price: Free to download with a 7-day free trial of every feature, then a one-time purchase of €19.99 (or the local App Store equivalent); no subscription
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/cinestager/id6755585287
- Website: https://cinestager.com/
- Maker: Yannick Giraud (cinematographer)
